test: three-transport link study, lab-01 <-> lab-02 (two Mac Studio M1 Max, 32 GB each)
method: benchmarks/link_benchmark.py — 7-point log-spaced payload ladder, 40 reps/size, 8 warm-up discarded, 200 latency round-trips, seed 42, TCP_NODELAY, 4 MiB socket buffers. Each rep is a full round trip. Source interface forced with --bind-local and the kernel route recorded.
corroboration: Published Thunderbolt Bridge throughput is ~10-20 Gbps against a 40 Gb/s nominal spec. This link negotiated at 20 Gb/s and delivered 17.2 Gbps (86%), placing it inside the expected band. A result near the 40 Gb/s nominal would have indicated a measurement error.
caveat: Payload is fixed-seed pseudorandom bytes, not model activations. This measures transport only; it does not include SAE forward-pass or inference cost.
